description: This file defines the NewKeyStoreDialog class, a GUI dialog for creating a new keystore in an Android development environment, including form handling, validation, and user interaction.

classes.name: NewKeyStoreDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for creating a new Android keystore, handling user input, validation, and form submission.

classes.name: MyNewKeyForm
classes.description: Inner class extending NewKeyForm, providing project context and keystore details.

methods.name: NewKeyStoreDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with project context and default keystore path.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Creates and returns the main panel of the dialog.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component to focus when dialog opens.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles OK button action, validating input and creating keystore.

methods.name: getKeyStorePath
methods.description: Returns the keystore path entered by the user.

methods.name: getKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the keystore password entered by the user.

methods.name: getKeyAlias
methods.description: Returns the key alias from the form.

methods.name: getKeyPassword
methods.description: Returns the key password from the form.
